headline: 🇨🇳 UNC3569 one-click Sogou RCE confirmed in the wild, 🌑 BlueMoon kit gains Defender patch bypass, 🇬🇷 Anubis details Greek healthcare attack, ☁️ AWS SSM Agent flaw exposes IAM credentials, 🚪 Suprema BioStar 2 leaks AD bind password, 🐧 Twin nfsd batches drop kernel 9.8s
summary: A confirmed one-click RCE chain in Tencent's Sogou Input Method and a Defender patch bypass on the BlueMoon exploit kit lead a day of exploited infrastructure, alongside AWS Session Manager credential theft, two remotely triggerable nfsd kernel batches, and ransomware details from a Greek healthcare attack.
